page.overview:
Who is Citizen Peanut?

Citizen Peanut is a character seen in the episode Summer Showers, and he is only seen in that episode. He plays the part of Wilfrid in the play Summer Showers.

Citizen Peanut looks like a giant peanut. He is seen wearing a grey overcoat and matching fedora. Underneath his coat, he wears a white button-up shirt with a red tie. This is most likely just the outfit he wore while playing the part of Wilfrid, though he is never seen wearing anything else.
